title: In shades of indiscriminate waves he plays on troughs of time cresting on hopes approaching shore #smallpoems #writingcommunity
summary: In shades of indiscriminate waves he plays on troughs of time cresting on hopes approaching shore #smallpoems #writingcommunity
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
In shades
of indiscriminate
waves
he plays on
troughs of
time
cresting on
hopes approaching
shore
